title: Strict pullback of cartesian fibrations with an isofibration comparison
statement: Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, products and degreewise pullbacks of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and cartesian and cocartesian fibrations and their edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $S,E_0,E_1,H$ be quasicategories in a fixed universe. Let $q_i:E_i\to S$ for $i=0,1$ be cartesian fibrations, let $r:H\to S$ be an inner fibration, and let $F_i:E_i\to H$ satisfy $rF_i=q_i$. Suppose each $F_i$ carries $q_i$-cartesian edges to $r$-cartesian edges, and $F_1$ is an isofibration, meaning an inner fibration that lifts equivalence edges with prescribed source. Form the degreewise pullback $P=E_0\times_H E_1$ and $q:P\to S$, $q(e_0,e_1)=q_0(e_0)=q_1(e_1)$. Then $P$ is a quasicategory and $q$ is a cartesian fibration. An edge $(e_0,e_1)$ of $P$ is $q$-cartesian if and only if $e_0$ is $q_0$-cartesian and $e_1$ is $q_1$-cartesian.
